pages.title: Subtitle Style
pages.note: Applies to text subtitles. ASS and SSA subtitles keep their own style, except the position.

pages.title: SponsorBlock
pages.note: Every YouTube video you play is checked on SponsorBlock, where viewers mark sponsors, self-promotion and similar segments. Only a short prefix of a hash of the video's ID is sent.Segments from SponsorBlock, under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

pages.title: Network
pages.note: These settings apply to http and https links. Other links, such as rtsp and rtmp, are opened by the player itself, and only the user agent applies to them.

pages.title: SubtitleCat.com
pages.note: Alabaster has no SubtitleCat.com account. Sign up and sign in in your browser. Search, download and translate use that browser's subtitlecat.com cookies for one request and do not save them.

settings.heading: General
settings.label: Stay on top
settings.tooltip: Keep the player window above other windows. Takes effect after a restart.
settings.notes: Not offered on Linux, where the window manager decides.

settings.heading: General
settings.label: Control playback with media keys globally

settings.heading: Video and sound
settings.label: Rotate videos to fit their cells
settings.tooltip: A landscape video in a cell taller than wide stands up, and a portrait video in a cell wider than tall lies down. A transform picked from the menu wins for that file.

settings.heading: Video and sound
settings.label: Turn direction
settings.notes: Enabled while Rotate videos to fit their cells is on.

settings.heading: Video and sound
settings.label: Volume step per wheel notch or key press
settings.tooltip: How much one wheel notch or volume key changes a cell's volume. Unmuting also starts at this level.

settings.heading: Tray
settings.label: Show icon in the tray
settings.notes: On macOS the label is Show icon in the menu bar. Greyed out, with the reason under it, where the desktop has no tray.

settings.heading: Tray
settings.label: Minimize to the tray
settings.notes: Enabled while Show icon in the tray is on. Forced on while Hide from the taskbar is on. On macOS the label is Minimize to the menu bar.

settings.heading: Tray
settings.label: Close to the tray
settings.notes: Enabled while Show icon in the tray is on. On macOS the label is Close to the menu bar.

settings.heading: Tray
settings.label: Hide from the taskbar
settings.notes: Enabled while Show icon in the tray is on. On macOS the label is Hide from the Dock. Greyed out on Wayland, and on GNOME, where it stops the window from minimizing.

settings.heading: Tray
settings.label: Stop video decoding while in the tray
settings.tooltip: Audio keeps playing. The picture may be black for a moment when you show the window.
settings.notes: Enabled while Show icon in the tray is on. On macOS the label is Stop video decoding while in the menu bar.

settings.heading: History
settings.label: Maximum size
settings.notes: Enabled while Enable recent list is on.

settings.heading: Timeouts
settings.label: Video initialization timeout
settings.tooltip: How long a video may take to open, or a live stream to start buffering, before it shows an error.

settings.heading: Timeouts
settings.label: Timeout
settings.notes: Enabled while Hide mouse after timeout is on.

settings.heading: Memory
settings.label: M3U size limit
settings.tooltip: Larger M3U, PLS and XSPF playlists, files or links, won't be loaded. IPTV lists can be hundreds of MB and take about 2.5 times their size in memory. GridPlayer's own playlists have no limit.

settings.heading: Cache
settings.label: Keep
settings.tooltip:
Where downloaded thumbnails and lists are kept.
On disk: kept after GridPlayer closes, up to the limit.
In memory: up to 32 MB, cleared when GridPlayer closes. Switching to it deletes the cache on disk.

settings.heading: Cache
settings.label: Limit
settings.tooltip: Maximum cache size on disk. The files used longest ago are deleted first.
settings.notes: Enabled while Keep is On disk.

settings.heading: Screenshots
settings.label: Folder
settings.tooltip: <data folder>/screenshots
settings.notes: Empty means the screenshots folder in the data folder.

settings.heading: Screenshots
settings.label: Quality
settings.notes: Enabled while Format is JPG.

settings.heading: Text
settings.label: Font
settings.notes: The choices are the fonts installed on the computer.

settings.heading: Text
settings.label: Size
settings.tooltip: Relative to VLC's size, which already scales with the video.

settings.heading: Effects
settings.label: Outline
settings.tooltip: Outline around the text. Keeps white text readable on bright pictures.

settings.heading: Effects
settings.label: Color
settings.notes: Enabled while Outline is Thin, Normal, Thick.

settings.heading: Effects
settings.label: Color
settings.notes: Enabled while Shadow is on.

settings.heading: Effects
settings.label: Background box
settings.tooltip: Draw text on a solid box, readable over any picture.

settings.heading: Effects
settings.label: Color
settings.notes: Enabled while Background box is on.

settings.heading: Position
settings.label: Raise from bottom
settings.tooltip: Distance from the bottom of the picture. Also applies to ASS and SSA subtitles.
settings.notes: The lowest value is shown as Default.

settings.label: Shortcuts
settings.notes: Stored as the changes from the default keymap. The defaults are listed in the Hotkeys reference.

settings.label: Language
settings.notes: The default is the system language when there is a translation for it, otherwise en_US. Takes effect after a restart.

settings.heading: Saving / Restoring
settings.label: Save all settings in the playlist
settings.tooltip: Saves every Playlist and New Videos setting in the playlist, so it plays the same anywhere. Later changes to these defaults no longer reach it.

settings.heading: Saving / Restoring
settings.label: Unsaved changes on close
settings.tooltip: Auto save only works for a playlist that's already saved to a file. Otherwise it discards or asks.

settings.heading: Saving / Restoring
settings.label: Save video paths relative to playlist file
settings.tooltip: So you can move the playlist together with its videos. Links and paths on another drive stay as they are.

settings.heading: Playback
settings.label: Pause background videos on single mode

settings.heading: Playback
settings.label: Share bookmarks between cells with the same file
settings.tooltip:
On: cells playing the same file share its bookmarks, and they stay when a cell closes.
Off: each cell has its own, removed when the cell closes.

settings.heading: Step Sizes
settings.label: Zoom
settings.tooltip: How much each zoom in or out step changes the zoom, as a share of the whole picture (100% = 1x), or of what's on screen with Proportional zoom.

settings.heading: Step Sizes
settings.label: Proportional zoom
settings.tooltip: Each step zooms by the same share of what's on screen, so it feels the same at 2x and 8x.

settings.heading: Folder Navigation
settings.label: Skip hidden and system files
settings.tooltip: Skip hidden files and folders, and system folders like the recycle bin.

settings.heading: Folder Navigation
settings.label: Scan limit
settings.tooltip:
How many files and folders to look through when a folder is added or next, previous and random go through subfolders, counting everything (folders, text files), not just media.
Stops a drop of a whole drive from hanging the app. 0 = no limit.
settings.notes: The lowest value is shown as No limit.

settings.heading: Folder Navigation
settings.label: Skip files open in other cells
settings.tooltip: Random play skips files already open in other cells when it can.

settings.heading: Sync
settings.label: Seek sync mode
settings.tooltip:
Seeking one video seeks the others too.
Percent: to the same share of their length.
Timecode: to the same time.

settings.heading: Sync
settings.label: Sync zoom and position
settings.tooltip: Zooming or panning one video does the same in the others.

settings.heading: Input
settings.label: Disable mouse click events
settings.tooltip: Clicks on a video do nothing, such as pause or single mode. Keys still work.

settings.heading: Input
settings.label: Disable mouse wheel events
settings.tooltip: The mouse wheel over a video does nothing, such as volume or seek. Keys still work.

settings.heading: Overlay
settings.label: Show overlay border for active video

settings.heading: Overlay
settings.label: Show full path in cell title
settings.tooltip: Local files show their whole path on the cell. A narrow cell cuts it in the middle. On software-overlay cells the whole path is in a tooltip; over hardware video cells there is no tooltip, so use single mode to see a long path in full. Links keep the name the page gives them.

settings.heading: Overlay
settings.label: Overlay timeout
settings.notes: Enabled while Hide overlay after timeout is on.

settings.heading: Grid
settings.label: Grid size
settings.tooltip: Cells per row (Rows First) or per column (Columns First). Auto (0) keeps the grid as square as it can.
settings.notes: Shown while Grid mode is Auto (Rows First), Auto (Columns First). The lowest value is shown as Auto.

settings.heading: Grid
settings.label: Fit grid cells
settings.tooltip: When the last row or column isn't full, its cells stretch to fill it.
settings.notes: Shown while Grid mode is Auto (Rows First), Auto (Columns First).

settings.heading: Grid
settings.label: Rows
settings.notes: Shown while Grid mode is Fixed Grid.

settings.heading: Grid
settings.label: Columns
settings.notes: Shown while Grid mode is Fixed Grid.

settings.heading: Grid
settings.label: Show all cells even when empty
settings.tooltip: Always show every row and column, with empty cells. When off, the grid shrinks to the cells in use.
settings.notes: Shown while Grid mode is Fixed Grid.

settings.heading: Drag-n-Drop
settings.label: In-window drag
settings.tooltip: Hold the "Hold to switch drop action" key (see Shortcuts) while dropping to do the other action.
settings.notes: On Linux the tooltip adds: On GNOME, dropping files from the file manager only honors Shift. Ctrl and Alt still work when dragging videos inside the player.

settings.heading: Drag-n-Drop
settings.label: File drop
settings.tooltip: Hold the "Hold to switch drop action" key (see Shortcuts) while dropping to do the other action.
settings.notes: On Linux the tooltip adds: On GNOME, dropping files from the file manager only honors Shift. Ctrl and Alt still work when dragging videos inside the player.

settings.heading: Drag-n-Drop
settings.label: Cells
settings.tooltip:
How many cells to use for added files, folders and playlists.
One per item: each file and folder gets its own cell.
One for all: everything in one cell.
One per video: every video gets its own cell, even inside folders and playlists.
Ask: choose each time.

settings.heading: Drag-n-Drop
settings.label: Warn about too many cells
settings.tooltip: Ask before adding more cells at once than the number below. Too many can freeze the player.

settings.heading: Drag-n-Drop
settings.label: Warn above
settings.tooltip: How many cells can be added at once without a warning.
settings.notes: Enabled while Warn about too many cells is on.

settings.heading: Lists
settings.label: List view
settings.tooltip: How items are shown in the List window: titles, titles with paths or links, or just paths or links.

settings.heading: Lists
settings.label: Thumbnails when available
settings.tooltip: Show thumbnails, channel, views and upload date for lists from sites like YouTube.

settings.heading: Lists
settings.label: Get info automatically
settings.tooltip: Look up titles, lengths and thumbnails for files and links you add to a list. When off, use Get Info in the List window.

settings.heading: Lists
settings.label: Update linked lists
settings.tooltip: How often linked lists update from their source. You can change it for each list in its List window.

settings.heading: Audio
settings.label: Audio track
settings.tooltip: Which audio track to start with: the file's default, one in your preferred languages, or none (no audio decoded, which isn't the same as muted).

settings.heading: Audio
settings.label: Languages
settings.tooltip: Language codes or names, best first. Videos that offer none of them keep their own default track.
settings.notes: Enabled while Audio track is Preferred Language.

settings.heading: Audio
settings.label: Detect external audio files
settings.tooltip: Offer audio files next to the video with the same name. They're opened only when you pick one.

settings.heading: Audio
settings.label: Volume
settings.tooltip: 1.00 is full volume (100%). While Muted is on, new videos start at 0% and this has no effect.

settings.heading: Audio
settings.label: Muted
settings.tooltip: New videos start muted, which is volume 0%. Unmuting starts at one volume step.

settings.heading: Subtitles
settings.label: Subtitles
settings.tooltip: Which subtitles to start with: none, ones in your preferred languages, or the file's default.

settings.heading: Subtitles
settings.label: Languages
settings.tooltip: Language codes or names, best first. Videos that offer none of them are shown without subtitles.
settings.notes: Enabled while Subtitles is Preferred Language.

settings.heading: Subtitles
settings.label: Text encoding
settings.tooltip: Encoding for subtitle files that aren't UTF-8. UTF-8 is detected automatically. Doesn't affect ASS and SSA subtitles.

settings.heading: Subtitles
settings.label: Detect external subtitle files
settings.tooltip: Offer subtitle files next to the video with the same name. They're opened only when you pick one.

settings.heading: Video
settings.label: Zoom to cursor
settings.tooltip: Zoom toward the mouse pointer instead of the alignment point. Resetting the zoom also recenters the picture.

settings.heading: Video
settings.label: View mode
settings.tooltip:
Fill: covers the cell, cutting off the edges.
Fit: the whole picture, with bars.
Stretch: covers the cell, changing the picture's shape.

settings.heading: Video
settings.label: Aspect ratio
settings.tooltip: The shape new videos are shown in. Default keeps each video's own, or the one its channel list gives. A ratio picked here wins over the list's.

settings.heading: Video
settings.label: Crop
settings.tooltip: Cut the picture to a shape, or by the margins below.

settings.heading: Video
settings.label: Margins
settings.notes: Enabled while Crop is Margins. Left, top, right and bottom margins in pixels, used when Crop is set to Margins.

settings.heading: Video
settings.label: Alignment
settings.tooltip: Where the picture sits in its cell: which side keeps it when it is cut or has bars. Zoom goes about this point too.

settings.heading: Video
settings.label: Allow moving past the edges
settings.tooltip: Let a moved or zoomed picture go past the cell's edges, as long as half of it stays in view.

settings.heading: Video
settings.label: Deinterlace
settings.tooltip:
Automatic: only videos marked as interlaced.
On: always. Use it if you see combing on moving edges.
Off: never.

settings.heading: Video
settings.label: Mode
settings.tooltip:
Auto: VLC chooses (currently X).
Yadif (2x), Bob and Phosphor double the frame rate, which costs more with many videos.
With hardware decoding, the GPU may use another mode it supports.
settings.notes: Enabled while Deinterlace is Automatic, On.

settings.heading: Playback
settings.label: Include subfolders
settings.tooltip: A dropped or added folder brings the files in its subfolders too, and next, previous and random files also come from subfolders.

settings.heading: Playback
settings.label: Other orientation
settings.tooltip: What next, previous and random do with a file whose orientation (portrait or landscape) is not the cell's.

settings.heading: Playback
settings.label: Files to play
settings.tooltip: Which files of the folder next, previous and random go on to. All media includes audio; Videos only skips audio and pictures.

settings.heading: Playback
settings.label: Slide duration
settings.tooltip: How long a picture shows before When finished is done.

settings.heading: Playback
settings.label: When list ends
settings.tooltip: What a cell playing a list does after the last item.

settings.heading: Playback
settings.label: When video fails
settings.tooltip: For cells playing a list. Play next doesn't reload a video that's gone or refused.

settings.heading: Playback
settings.label: Next after
settings.notes: Enabled while When video fails is Play next. The lowest value is shown as At once.

settings.heading: Streaming Videos
settings.label: Adapt after
settings.tooltip: How long a video must keep its new size before Auto quality adjusts.
settings.notes: Enabled while Stream quality is Auto (fit to pane).

settings.heading: Streaming Videos
settings.label: Attempts
settings.notes: Enabled while On network error is Reload a few times.

settings.heading: Streaming Videos
settings.label: Auto reload time
settings.tooltip: Live streams only: reload the stream every this many minutes. 0 = never.
settings.notes: The lowest value is shown as Disabled.

settings.heading: Resolvers
settings.label: Use Streamlink for HLS streams when possible
settings.tooltip: For live HLS streams that Streamlink opens, Streamlink fetches them. Off, or for recorded HLS, the player's own HLS proxy does.

settings.heading: Resolvers
settings.label: Priority URL resolver
settings.tooltip: Which resolver tries a link first; the others follow if it can't. YouTube links always use yt-dlp. The patterns below can pick another for some links.

settings.heading: yt-dlp
settings.label: JavaScript runtime
settings.tooltip: Folder with a deno binary, tried before PATH. Deno is not bundled: install it yourself (for example winget install DenoLand.Deno or brew install deno). Node, qjs and bun are only used with the option below on. Leave empty to use deno from PATH.

settings.heading: yt-dlp
settings.label: Allow JavaScript engines found on PATH
settings.tooltip: Also use node, qjs and bun, and look on PATH, in the data folder, Homebrew and the installers' home folders. A binary there can be replaced by another program. Off: deno only, from the folder above or PATH.

settings.heading: yt-dlp
settings.label: External yt-dlp
settings.tooltip: yt-dlp program that resolves links: a full path, or just yt-dlp to use the one on PATH (for example from winget install yt-dlp.yt-dlp or brew install yt-dlp; you keep it updated). Empty, or not found: the yt-dlp module built into the app.
settings.notes: Used for resolving links; the checkups and cookie-browser list still use the built-in module.

settings.heading: Resolver priority patterns
settings.label: Resolver priority patterns
settings.notes: A table of URL patterns (wildcard host, wildcard URL or regex) and the resolver each one picks.

settings.heading: Categories
settings.label: Sponsor
settings.notes: Enabled while Use SponsorBlock on YouTube videos is on.

settings.heading: Categories
settings.label: Unpaid/Self Promotion
settings.notes: Enabled while Use SponsorBlock on YouTube videos is on.

settings.heading: Categories
settings.label: Interaction Reminder
settings.notes: Enabled while Use SponsorBlock on YouTube videos is on.

settings.heading: Categories
settings.label: Intermission/Intro Animation
settings.notes: Enabled while Use SponsorBlock on YouTube videos is on.

settings.heading: Categories
settings.label: Endcards/Credits
settings.notes: Enabled while Use SponsorBlock on YouTube videos is on.

settings.heading: Categories
settings.label: Preview/Recap
settings.notes: Enabled while Use SponsorBlock on YouTube videos is on.

settings.heading: Categories
settings.label: Hook/Greetings
settings.notes: Enabled while Use SponsorBlock on YouTube videos is on.

settings.heading: Categories
settings.label: Filler Tangent
settings.notes: Enabled while Use SponsorBlock on YouTube videos is on.

settings.heading: Categories
settings.label: Non-Music Section
settings.notes: Enabled while Use SponsorBlock on YouTube videos is on.

settings.heading: Categories
settings.label: Highlight
settings.notes: Enabled while Use SponsorBlock on YouTube videos is on.

settings.label: Browser
settings.tooltip: Read cookies from this browser when yt-dlp resolves a link, the same as --cookies-from-browser. Nothing is saved.
settings.notes: The choices are the browsers this yt-dlp can read cookies from.

settings.label: Profile
settings.tooltip: Optional profile name or path. Empty uses the browser's most recently used profile.

settings.heading: Proxy
settings.label: Proxy
settings.tooltip:
System: use your computer's proxy settings.
None: connect directly.
Custom: use the proxy address you enter.

settings.heading: Proxy
settings.label: Proxy address
settings.notes: Enabled while Proxy is Custom.

settings.heading: Connection
settings.label: Request timeout
settings.tooltip: How long to wait for a site to answer while opening a link. Doesn't affect playback. Auto (0) leaves each library its own default.
settings.notes: The lowest value is shown as Auto.

settings.heading: Connection
settings.label: User agent
settings.tooltip: How the player identifies itself to sites. Leave empty for the default.

settings.heading: Connection
settings.label: Force IPv4
settings.tooltip: Connect over IPv4 only. Try this if links stall or a site blocks your IPv6 address.

settings.heading: Security
settings.label: Verify TLS certificates
settings.tooltip: Turn this off only for a proxy that signs traffic with its own certificate.

settings.heading: Security
settings.label: Allow http links in https playlists
settings.tooltip: Some streams have an https playlist that links to http video. Turn this off to block those links.

settings.label: Enable SubtitleCat.com
settings.tooltip: Adds Find subtitles on SubtitleCat.com to a cell's Subtitles menu.

settings.label: Request translations
settings.tooltip: Lets the SubtitleCat.com window ask the site to translate a subtitle. One request per click, never retried; the site's reply, a limit or VIP message too, is shown as sent. Needs SubtitleCat.com enabled.
settings.notes: Enabled while Enable SubtitleCat.com is on.

settings.heading: Video Decoder
settings.label: Decoder
settings.tooltip: Hardware decodes on the GPU, Software on the CPU. SP (single process) plays every video in the player's own process; the others spread videos over VLC processes. Dummy plays nothing. Videos reload when changed.
settings.notes: On macOS the default is Hardware SP and Hardware is not offered. Where hardware video can't run (Wayland without Xwayland), the Software twin is used and the reason is added to the tooltip.

settings.heading: Video Decoder
settings.label: Videos per process
settings.tooltip: How many videos share one VLC process, for Hardware and Software.
settings.notes: Enabled while Decoder is Software, Hardware.

settings.heading: VLC Options
settings.label: VLC Options
settings.tooltip: Extra VLC command-line options for every video. Options that open a server, stream out or turn on Lua are dropped. Videos reload when changed.
settings.notes: Written as on the VLC command line, for example --network-caching=1000.

settings.heading: Experimental
settings.label: Opaque overlay (fix black screen)
settings.notes: Greyed out where hardware video can't run.

settings.heading: Experimental
settings.label: Fake overlay invisibility (fix overlay on top of other windows)
settings.notes: Greyed out where hardware video can't run.

settings.heading: Experimental
settings.label: Force native drag-n-drop for in-window drag

settings.heading: Experimental
settings.label: HW video border fix
settings.tooltip: Crops a few pixels off the edges to hide glitches from hardware video. Auto uses the default for your system.
settings.notes: Greyed out where hardware video can't run.

settings.heading: Log file
settings.label: Limit log file size
settings.tooltip: Start a new log file when it reaches the size below, keeping that many old ones. Takes effect after a restart.

settings.heading: Log file
settings.label: Log file size
settings.notes: Enabled while Limit log file size is on. Takes effect after a restart.

settings.heading: Log file
settings.label: Log files to keep
settings.notes: Enabled while Limit log file size is on. Takes effect after a restart.
